taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: HTML cross-document/channel messaging; validate origin, peer and message contract

controls.boundary: Browser postMessage peer and capability trust — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect message listeners, expected origins, window/source handles, channel transfer and action schemas. Determine whether a frame can navigate after a trust decision.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned local origins: the expected peer and an unauthorized peer. Send the same inert privileged-action request and record whether the receiver commits it or returns protected fixture data. Test exact origin/source binding at the action and reply boundary; for transferred ports, trace who obtained the capability.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A missing origin comparison is not conclusive if a separately trusted port/source capability enforces the policy. A wildcard reply exposing only public handshake data is not a confidential-data leak.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind the approved peer/channel to each sensitive action and recipient; validate message shape and resource authority. Retest the legitimate peer and the unauthorized origin, including the evidenced navigation lifecycle.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
